description_en: Verifies the validity period of an identity document as a two-factor authentication element
description_zh: 身份二要素有效期核验
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl id-2-meta-period-verify-intl --product-code eKYC_Date_MIN --scene-code 1234567890 --merchant-biz-id e0c34a77f5ac40a5aa5e6ed20c350000 --merchant-user-id 1234567890 --doc-type '​00000001' --doc-name '张三' --doc-no 411xxxxxxxxxxx0001 --validity-start-date 20201001 --validity-end-date 20301001 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Id2MetaPeriodVerifyIntl

parameters.help_en:
The product solution to use.

Set the value to eKYC_Date_MIN
parameters.help_zh:
要接入的产品方案。

取值eKYC_Date_MIN
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The custom authentication scenario ID. You can use this scenario ID to query related records in the console. The value can be up to 10 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores
parameters.help_zh: 您自定义的认证场景ID，用于后续控制台输入此场景ID查询相关记录使用。支持长度为10位的字母、数字或下划线的组合
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en: The custom unique business identifier, which is used for subsequent troubleshooting. The value can be up to 32 characters in length and can contain letters and digits. Make sure the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持长度为32位的字母和数字的组合，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The custom user ID or another identifier that can identify a specific user, such as a phone number or email address. We strongly recommend that you desensitize the value of this field in advance, for example, by hashing the value
parameters.help_zh: 您自定义的用户ID，或者其他可以识别特定用户的标识，例如手机号码、邮箱地址等。强烈建议对该字段的值进行预先脱敏，例如对值进行哈希处理
parameters.name: merchant_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The document type, which is uniquely identified by an 8-digit number. For more information, see the document type list.

Currently, only the second-generation resident identity card of the Chinese mainland is supported. Set this parameter to 00000001
parameters.help_zh:
证件类型，以8位数字组合作为唯一标识。更多说明，请参见证件类型列表。
当前支持中国内地第二代居民身份证，请传入固定值：00000001
parameters.name: doc_type

parameters.help_en: The document number of the user
parameters.name: doc_no

parameters.help_en: The start date of the validity period, in the format YYYYMMDD. Example: 20201001
parameters.help_zh: 有效期开始日期，格式：YYYYMMDD。如：20201001
parameters.name: validity_start_date

parameters.help_en: The expiration date of the ID card validity period, in the format YYYYMMDD. Example: 20301001
parameters.help_zh: 身份证有效期到期日期，格式：YYYYMMDD。如：20301001
parameters.name: validity_end_date
